g.title: 'dynamic_array["$(echo "$key" | md5sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"]="$(echo "Value for $key" | base64 & wait $!)" (&)' (1,759 us, 0.03%)

'$'''tee >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch1: $n" 1>&2 &
done) >(while read -r n, do

done) (&)' (825 us, 0.01%)

'$'''echo "$({ echo "Level 2" & echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&' (900 us, 0.01%)
